admission.justification: The owner-validation test matrix prevents a stale change set from being restored merely because an enclosure or a same-ID task in another repository or master survives.

applicability: Remembered change-set targets, including leaf, review, comparison, master-net and enclosure-alias variants, when Operations validates ownership on return.
conditions: The current task population carries the exact repository and master-qualified owner.
A server-carried task placeholder counts as present; no additional stub classification is imposed.
An enclosure alias must still identify its exact current leaf or master owner.
exclusions: Inferring existence from a surviving enclosure alone.
Using another repository's or another master's task with the same ID as the owner.

evidence: producer-proof-locators.json: BUG-L5-R1-014; dashboard/src/cockpit/tabMemory.test.ts :: keeps $name while its owning task exists; dashboard/src/cockpit/tabMemory.test.ts :: dismisses $name after its owning task is removed; dashboard/src/cockpit/tabMemory.test.ts :: dismisses $name when its task is gone and its enclosure is still projected; dashboard/src/cockpit/tabMemory.test.ts :: keeps $name until the task population is hydrated; dashboard/src/cockpit/tabMemory.test.ts :: dismisses $name when only another repository holds its task id; dashboard/src/cockpit/tabMemory.test.ts :: dismisses $name when only another master holds its task id; dashboard/src/cockpit/tabMemory.test.ts :: keeps $name from its task-bound worktree without a separate enclosure; dashboard/src/cockpit/tabMemory.test.ts :: keeps $name when its enclosure is projected apart from its task; dashboard/src/cockpit/tabMemory.test.ts :: dismisses $name when another task retains its orphaned worktree; dashboard/src/cockpit/tabMemory.test.ts :: dismisses an enclosure scope that no current task or enclosure names

statement: Every remembered change-set variant requires its current owning task in the same repository and master after hydration, even when its enclosure or another task survives.
